title: BBS CML
description: A different view of what the BBS mod is.
body:
# 🌟 BBS CML

**BBS CML** is a veteran fork of BBS with a distinct vision compared to the original version and other forks. Its main goal is to improve and streamline various features used for animation, ensuring a much better quality of life for animators.

> **⚙️ Compatibility:**
> Fully compatible with Minecraft versions **1.20.1, 1.20.4, 1.21.1, and 1.21.4**.
> *(Note: Please use Sinytra Connector if you are running Forge or NeoForge).*

---

### 🚀 Welcome to 2.0 - Part 1

CML is undergoing a complete overhaul! We are continuously improving quality-of-life elements and laying the groundwork for exciting new features. What has been improved in this new vision of BBS?

#### 🎬 A Completely New Film Editor

The film editor’s design has been entirely revamped. You can now fully customize the layout to fit your personal workflow perfectly. It also introduces powerful new features, including:

* Camera effect clips
* Hotbar clips
* Limbs-tracks
* PBR controller
* *And much more!*

![Enderman](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c26606e42ef35ed8977684458722e533bb6e0dc9.png)

![Luz](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/acb173390afa7fc2ead5a86ac120ea5b0a8d20e1.png)

#### 🖼️ New Form List Selector

Do you love grid/mosaic layouts? Then this is for you! The interface has been completely rebuilt to provide small visual previews of your everyday models. You also have the freedom to disable or hide categories you don't want to see.

![Forms](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/273d5cdb62784f3f612d640d7e478947ab253efc_0.webp)

#### 🧩 Built-in Addon System

CML now features a robust addon system. You can easily use extensions created specifically for this fork, such as the **AAAddon**, **Photon Addon**, and **FBX Addon**.

![AAA](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0f88a5afcdd2b82383d3c7e5056e95795dc9c5c1_0.webp)

---

### ✨ Additional Features

* **Live mirror** on bones
* Native **Structure Form**
* **Shape Form**
* **Fluid Form**
* Compatibility with **glTF** and **Mine-imator** models
* In-game audio rendering
* View bobbing when playing back in first-person
* BBS project exporting
* Triggers block
* A revamped Texture Editor
* Model Editor
* Geometry Editor
* *...and many more changes!*

![Home](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/06809fb26bdae51d37939d6aa7770c66d5ef47c3_0.webp)
